learning_outcomes.text: Investigate and solve basic problems of power systems.
Have general knowledge about the device and apparatus characteristics of the power systems.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to energy systems and basic definitions and apparatus.
Power calculation for single phase a.c. systems (power computation R, L, C, R-L and RLC circuits).
Reactive power compensation for single phase systems and solution of examples.
Fundamental design, construction and usage properties of modern high voltage capacitors.
Introduction to three phase systems and analysis of current and voltage phasors.
Three phase generator and transformer phasor analysis in terms of connection types (Delta or Star).
Combination of generator and load connections for three phase systems and power analysis
Single line diagrams of three phase systems and power transformers.
Power cables and practical computation methods.
Introduction to short circuit computations for low voltage systems and examples.
Fuses, contactors, circuit breakers for power systems. Measurement methods for low voltage systems.
Grounding (earthing) concept and methods. Introduction to touch and step voltages.
Stability and Smart Grids in energy systems.
